meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Dask 把放不进内存的数据切成小块并行计算，也能把任务分到多台机器。它支持表格、数组、文本等多文件处理，并可将现有 pandas/NumPy 代码改造为并行版本。
howto.when: 当数据超过内存、需要并行处理多个文件，或要把 pandas/NumPy 操作扩展到集群时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Dask to chunk data too large for memory and process it in parallel, or distribute tasks across machines. It handles dataframes, arrays, text, multi-file I/O, and adapts existing pandas/NumPy code into parallel workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when data exceeds available RAM, when parallelizing multiple file processing, or when extending pandas/NumPy operations to a cluster.
